about_the_game:
Veilwalkers is a dark, atmospheric roguelike deck builder where every card you play builds momentum — and every mistake could be your last. Lead a band of cursed heroes through shifting realms, mastering powerful cards, relics, and blessings in turn-based combat against eldritch horrors and corrupted foes. Strategize, adapt, and push forward into the unknown, one card at a time. Will you break the veil… or be consumed by it?

The world has been corrupted by the veil-dust that has caused wildlife to become savage corrupted beasts. New and dangerous enemies now roam the world! Because of this cursed hero's have taken up the mantle to rid the world of these creatures and restore balance and order to the once peaceful kingdom! Gear up and get ready to take on the veil and its all corruption! 

The world is dangerous. You must outfit your hero with the different gear you find out on your adventures! Gear will upgrade your hero's effectiveness at dealing with the monsters you find out in the world. Depending on what you outfit your hero with can determine the course and survival of your hero's! Face these monsters, grow more powerful & end the suffering the kingdom faces due to the Veil dust's corruption! 

Your cards will make and break your runs! The veil-dust may have created enemies but, also created allies! Visit the Veilmage to upgrade your cards and make them stronger! This way you can stand a chance against the foes ahead on your journey! Encounter more cards on your journey and build a deck to defeat even the strongest foes! 

Where there is disaster you can expect to find someone trying to turn a profit! Traveling merchants roam the dangerous forests selling gear & cards that you can use on your journey! Make sure to keep an eye out for these individuals to acquire items to make yourself stronger for your journey!
